title: Solution of uniform Turán's Tetrahedron Problem
summary: Turán's Tetrahedron Problem asks to determine the Turán density of the complete hypergraph $K_4^{(3)}$ (tetrahedron). This problem, posed by Turán in 1941, is one of the most famous problems in extremal combinatorics and its solution would attract \$500 prize from Erdős. In the 1980s, Erdős and Sós asked to determine Turán densities of $K_4^{(3)-}$ (broken tetrahedron) and $K_4^{(3)}$ (tetrahedron) when edges are constrained to be uniformly distributed in the host hypergraph.
